knowledge.title: How do I reset my password?
knowledge.content: Open Settings → Security → Reset password. We email you a secure link that is valid for 60 minutes. If it expires, just request a new one.
knowledge.summary: Reset your password from Settings → Security.

knowledge.title: What video formats are supported?
knowledge.content: You can upload MP4, MOV and WebM files up to 4GB each. For best results export at 1080p or higher.

knowledge.title: How does billing work?
knowledge.content: Plans are billed monthly. You can upgrade, downgrade or cancel any time from Settings → Billing. Cancelling keeps access until the end of the current period.
